events.title: Crafternoon for Adults, Tweens and Teens

cases.refreshed: Come unwind and learn something new at our monthly crafternoon! No experience is necessary. Supplies will be provided, and you're welcome to bring any of your own. In fact, some of these crafts may benefit from your personal stash! The activities will be suitable for ages 10 and up. We will have project samples each day to help you visualize the end result. Programs will be on the fourth Sunday of the month. • October – Cardboard Nicho. Recommended items to bring: small images of a cherished item, symbol, memory, or a loved one you miss. • November – Embossing Aluminum Food Charms. Recommended items to bring: colorful Sharpies. • December – Felt and Beaded Patches. Recommended items to bring: old jewelry you don't mind disassembling, beads, colorful thread, loose buttons, scraps of fabric and lace. ¡Ven a relajarte y a aprender algo nuevo en nuestra tarde mensual de artesanías! No se necesita experiencia. Se proporcionarán los materiales, pero puedes traer los que quieras. De hecho, ¡algunas de estas artesanías pueden beneficiarse de tus propios materiales! Las actividades serán aptas para mayores de 10 años. Cada día tendremos ejemplos de proyectos para ayudarte a visualizar el resultado final. • Agosto – Paisaje de playa en collage • Septiembre – Pintura de hongos • Octubre – Nicho de cartón. Materiales recomendados para traer: imágenes pequeñas de un objeto preciado, un símbolo, un recuerdo o un ser querido al que extrañas. • Noviembre – Dijes de aluminio con relieve. Artículos recomendados para traer: marcadores Sharpie de colores. Piensa en cuál es tu comida reconfortante. • Diciembre – Parches de fieltro y cuentas. Artículos recomendados para traer: joyas viejas que no te importe desarmar, cuentas, hilo de colores, botones sueltos, retazos de tela y encaje.

cases.refreshed: Our quarterly 4-Day Sales feature a large number of books and media from all genres. The sales begin with a preview evening exclusively for Friends members and end with a Bargain Day. Prices at 4-Day Sales are as follows: Books: $1.50 per inch; CDs: (music and software) 4 for $1.00; Audiobooks, DVDs, VCDs and Blu-ray discs: $1 each; Software and games: $1 each or as marked; Box sets of DVDs, CDs, or VCDs: individually priced based on the number of discs in the set; Specialty items: Individually priced; Bargain Day Sales: $5 per paper grocery bag full of books and media. We accept the following forms of payment: Cash & Checks; All major credit cards; Apple Pay & Google Pay; Contactless payment available. Thursday, December 3 is members-only night. Doors open from 5:00 PM until 8:00 PM. For Thursday night access to the sale, enter at the rear (east side) of the library. You must have a valid membership card for entry, or purchase a membership at the door. Individual memberships allow 1 person to enter; family memberships allow the entire family to enjoy the book sale. You must be present to hold a place in line – you cannot "save" your spot with boxes or other items. Learn more about memberships. Friday, December 4 is open to the public. Doors open from 10:00 AM until 5:00 PM. Saturday, December 5 is open to the public. Doors open from 10:00 AM until 5:00 PM. Sunday, December 6 is open to the public and is bargain day. Doors open from 10:00 AM until 4:00 PM. Other ongoing Friends of the Milpitas Library sales include the Book Nook. We have a variety of great books available at great prices every day in the Book Nook behind the accounts desk on the first floor. All books are 50% off every Sunday. Amazon sales: We have a large catalog of books for sale on Amazon, and we try to offer the lowest price for every title that we list. The next time you're shopping for a used book on Amazon, look for our seller name: Friends of the Milpitas Community Library. eBay sales: View our current listings on eBay. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.
